Versioned 2026-10-07 for the operator's two-source ruling. A wallet address, rather than already-read outputs, lets discovery defer the wallet read until a needed role is missing from the provider. Nothing supplies no wallet fallback.

Only needed roles are queried. When the provider supplies all of them, the wallet is not read; with no needed roles, no discovery read occurs. Each role uses the lowest locally admitted output reference within the first source that supplies it.
